entities.summary: Coby Scott Bell is an American actor. He is best known for his roles as Jesse Porter on the USA Network original series Burn Notice and professional football player Jason Pitts on The CW/BET comedy-drama The Game. He also co-starred as Officer Davis from the Everett Police Department and as Aaron in the Amazon original series Mad Dogs.
